features: selfcheck reports the runtime, the binary, the database and the tools
validate accepts the minimal script and rejects an unknown step
plan names each step, the ffmpeg graph and the assets
estimate prices a script from pricing.json without calling a provider
each paid estimate line names its provider, model, units, usd, sourceUrl and checkedAt
a step that is already in the step cache is estimated at 0
pricing.json holds one entry per provider and model with unit, usdPerUnit, sourceUrl and checkedAt
a speech clip names its provider, model and voice; no voice is built in
a provider registered only in a test runs through plan, estimate, the step cache and render
a script that names an unknown provider or model is refused by validate
render writes a video for a script that needs no key
the same script, assets and seed render the same frames
verify checks duration, frame count, resolution, audio and title frames
verify names a wrong duration or a missing frame, not a missing tool
a clip smaller or larger than the output fills its scheduled time
a logo with transparency shows the background through it
no command hangs when the caller leaves stdin open
a speech step without its provider's key fails with E_NO_KEY and names the variable
estimate and plan list secretsNeeded: one entry per missing variable of an uncached paid step, with provider, steps and usd
secretsNeeded is empty when every key is set or every paid step is cached, and is not part of planSha256
render checks every paid step before the first call: data.missing lists the missing variables and no provider is called
a key value is never in the database, the cache, the plan, the ledger, the output or anything printed
--offline replaces every paid step with its free fallback, marks it, costs 0.000000 and opens no socket
the four samples render offline to the same file twice, the same file as their captions-only form
guide tells an assistant to show the estimate, ask once per listed variable and never write a key
elevenlabs-speech speaks a line with the voice id the script names, priced per character, with the owner's ELEVENLABS_API_KEY
speech on ElevenLabs and scenes on xAI with only XAI_API_KEY set: one entry, ELEVENLABS_API_KEY, for the speech steps alone
render then stops with E_NO_KEY for that one variable before any call, and nothing is listed once the speech is cached
expand fills a template with an inputs file and the owner's brand file and returns a video script
the same template and inputs expand to the same bytes and plan to the same planSha256 in fresh processes on another day
changing one input of a sample changes only that step's key and the output's key
an unknown input, a missing required input and a value of the wrong type are refused, each with its document and place
substitution is plain: an expression in a slot is refused and a value is never expanded again
a step whose slot has no value takes the fallback the template names, and expand lists it
three starter templates ship in templates/ and in the binary, each with budget.maxUsd 5 and no business name
the four samples go from their template, inputs and brand to a validated, planned, priced, offline-rendered and verified video
every sample script.json is exactly what expand writes from its inputs.json
guide lists the starter templates with their inputs and text
a generated_scene clip names its provider, model, prompt, duration and fallback, and is priced per second or per picture
a scene that is not ready in time fails with E_PENDING; the retry polls the stored request id, sends nothing again and is billed once
the request id of a scene is stored under its step key before the first poll and dropped when the result is stored
a stored request the provider no longer knows (404 or 410) is dropped and sent again; any other failed poll keeps it, and --resend drops it on request
every scene of a video is sent before the first one is waited for
a generated scene is cached across jobs: the second job calls nothing and adds no ledger line
--offline shows the fallback of a generated scene for the same time: the owner's picture, video or a title card
frames of a generated scene carry the script's disclosure text, other frames do not, and a script with such a scene needs that text
every render writes a manifest next to the video: template id, templateVersion, planSha256, and per step provider, model, stepKey, cached and usd
validate refuses a scene the named provider cannot make and a fallback file that is missing or too short
a template can show a generated_scene with slots, and each starter template sets the default disclosure text
a lip_sync clip names its provider, model, presenter file and voice track, and only a script or template that asks for it has one
lip-sync is estimated per frame of the clip at the output fps (30 s at 25 fps is 750 frames), with sourceUrl and checkedAt
sync-lipsync uploads the presenter and the mixed sound once with the owner's SYNC_API_KEY, and downloads the result without the key
the step key of a lip_sync step chains to the presenter file and to the speech steps and audio files it hears
a lip-sync that is not ready in time fails with E_PENDING; the retry polls the stored request id, uploads nothing again and is billed once
a lip-synced clip is cached across jobs: the second job calls nothing and adds no ledger line
--offline shows the presenter as it is, or a mouth drawn on the owner's picture that opens with the loudness of the recorded sound
the drawn mouth costs 0.000000, opens no socket and gives the same file twice
frames of a lip-synced clip carry the script's disclosure text, and a script with such a clip needs that text
jobs and ledger read the database without changing it
the four fictional sample projects validate and plan with no key
a name scan keeps company names out of src, schemas, templates, examples and the docs
plan prints the same canonical bytes and planSha256 whatever --now and --seed are
changing one input changes only that step's key and the output's key
a new job with the same paid inputs uses the step cache and adds no ledger line
two renders with every paid step cached write the same file
cache list reads the step cache, and cache prune removes entries only when asked
a result found in another cache folder is copied in without a call or a ledger line
two renders at the same time on one database with two cache folders call a step key once
a removed result is called again and gets its own ledger line, so the ledger equals the reported cost
the model check rejects a call for a stored result, a line without a call and a call without a line
guide prints a short example script that validates and renders with no key and no media files
--help and --version exit 0 with one envelope, and --version reports the version
selfcheck stays ok without Playwright and warns that only screen_recording needs it
the default video is H.264 yuv420p for browsers, and output.encode: lossless keeps exact RGB
brand.font is a font file next to the script, and a font name is refused
captions are drawn only by a from track, one voiceover or speech segment at a time
estimate and render stop with E_BUDGET before any provider call when the uncached paid steps cost more than budget.maxUsd; data names estimate, cap and source
--max-usd on estimate and render lowers the cap for one run; the lower of it and budget.maxUsd applies
a step that is already in the step cache counts as 0 against the cap, so a cached rerun passes under a cap the first run would not
a refused render calls no provider, adds no ledger line, creates no job and writes no file
each of the four sample projects goes from its template and brand file through expand, validate, plan, estimate, a render with a fake provider and verify, and passes the name scan
